name: Pooja R. Sonar
tagline: A passionate Software Developer adept at building real-time, scalable web applications and AI-powered platforms, leveraging the MERN stack and robust backend technologies.
about: A results-driven Software Developer and B.Tech graduate (CGPA: 9.2) with a strong foundation in Data Structures, Algorithms, and Object-Oriented Programming. I possess hands-on experience architecting real-time systems, developing scalable web applications, and contributing to AI-powered platforms. Recognized for robust problem-solving, leadership capabilities, and a commitment to continuous learning, demonstrated through hackathon successes and diverse internship experiences.
highlights: Architected real-time telemetry (10K+ readings/min) via Cosmos DB and Node.js; achieved 99.9% uptime.
Integrated Socket.IO and MQTT to serve 500+ farms with <100ms UI latency.
Built Next.js (TypeScript) + Redux dashboards for 50+ sensor cards with <200ms refresh.
Built and maintained scalable web applications using Next.js and TypeScript, optimizing front-end performance and UX.
Implemented RabbitMQ message-driven flows for decoupling services and enhancing reliability.
Secured 3rd place in a Hackathon organized by GDSC ADGITM.
Developed an AI-powered, gamified coding platform to help users learn programming languages with Gemini's API.

projects.name: AccessAI - CodeQuest (MERN)
projects.description: Developed an AI-powered, gamified platform, CodeQuest, designed to enhance programming language learning. The platform offers comprehensive educational content, engaging coding challenges, and AI-driven assistance via Gemini's API, supporting languages and frameworks like Solidity, JavaScript, CSS, and React.

projects.name: Chess.com Backend Clone (MERN)
projects.description: Engineered a robust backend clone, leveraging the MERN stack, to replicate core Chess.com gameplay functionalities. Implemented Socket.IO WebSockets for seamless, real-time synchronization of game states, moves, clocks, and player actions like resign/draw. Designed and secured RESTful Express APIs for managing users, games, moves, and sessions, incorporating JWT (access+refresh tokens), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), rate limiting, and CORS policies.
